name: Underline Tabs
description: Tabs whose underline stretches and glides between labels on two springs, with quiet counts, overflow arrows over soft edge fades and panels that cross-fade 6px.

props.name: label
props.description: The tab list's accessible name. It is not drawn; the heading above the tabs carries the visible title.

props.name: items
props.description: The tabs, each with a value, a label, a panel (content) and optional count and disabled flag. Leave out to use the built-in project console.

props.name: tabs
props.description: How many built-in tabs to show, from 2 to 8: Overview, Deployments, Logs, Analytics, Domains, Variables, Storage, Settings. Ignored when items is given.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection. Update it from onValueChange. If it names no enabled tab, the first enabled one shows.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Runs when a different tab is opened by pointer or keyboard. Opening the selected tab again does nothing.

props.name: counts
props.description: Shows each tab's count after its label in tabular figures and a quieter ink.

props.name: activation
props.description: Auto opens a tab as the arrow keys reach it. Manual only moves focus; Enter or Space opens the focused tab. Use manual when a panel is expensive to render.

props.name: indicator
props.description: A 2px line under the selected label, or a raised pill behind the whole tab. Both glide with a leading and a trailing edge.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the underline, the one accent. Defaults to the theme's ink. The pill stays neutral.

props.name: theme
props.description: Ink, rail, pill and arrow colours for a near-black or a light surface.
